acceptance_evidence: unittest output showing the new regression tests fail before the change and pass after; test_shiki_doctor.sh green
completion_conditions: For an absent defaults.required_review, an absent or empty mergegate.required_checks, and required_code_owner_review: true with required_review absent, doctor's branch-protection inputs equal shiki_config's; regression tests cover all three and fail before the change.
The explicit-required_review pin in test_doctor_agrees_with_shiki_config_on_code_owner_review is removed.
non_goals: Do not change shiki_config or mergegate_check defaults; the operative readers are correct and changing them would weaken the merge gate.
Do not change GitHub branch protection or reconcile the mismatch doctor reports.
outcome: shiki_doctor stops maintaining its own copies of shiki_config's config rules over a different parser. All three mirrors are deleted and doctor reads the canonical configured_* helpers, so doctor's branch-protection judgement cannot silently disagree with the value that actually configures protection and gates the merge.
title: Make shiki doctor read branch-protection policy through shiki_config instead of restating it
